name: Meteor Maw · Voidstone style
role: Boss style · Meteor Fall (void meteors, weighted to Apex) · same abilities
notes: Same rig, bones, animations and hitbox as Meteor Maw; only textures and added boxes change.
Crying obsidian from the void under the sky: near-black stone with magenta cracks, a magenta maw, and two crystal shards floating above the shoulders.
The floating shards are on the spikes bone and bob in idle. Magenta is kept apart from the violet splinter so the core still reads clearly.
Spawns when a Meteor Fall event rolls a void meteor; weighted toward Greater and Apex.
